name: 50 — Event Delivery to ClickHouse
description:
Tests 100% event delivery from gateway to ClickHouse.

🔧 Gateway Config:
• Token: test-gateway-token-12345
• NO app assigned → Direct path (fast)
• Model: fast (mock provider)
• Expected: 100/100 requests in PG AND ClickHouse

📊 Verification:
• PG: gateway_requests count
• CH: events_gateway_request count
• Field integrity: request_id, model, tokens match

⚠️ Prerequisites:
• DUAL mode: THE_M_EVENTS_GATEWAY=dual
• Event-writer running
• ClickHouse healthy
